name: GetDimensions
caption: Get Dimensions

configuration.description: SmartField reference to the record, written as exactly one placeholder in double braces, e.g. "{{trigger_Rec}}" or "{{FindCustomers_results}}". An undotted name is looked up directly (an array reference such as {{FindX_results}} resolves to its first element); a dotted path (e.g. {{trigger_Rec.Customer}}) is walked through the SmartField definitions. Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Anything else fails at runtime. The table must have a 'Dimension Set ID' field.
Table number of the referenced record. The editor derives it from the reference; it must match the resolved record at runtime.
Dimensions to read. Each row (distinct output name) produces three value outputs.

items.description: Dimension to read: a dimension code (e.g. 'DEPARTMENT'), a General Ledger Setup slot 'GLSETUP:SHORTCUTDIMENSION1'..'GLSETUP:SHORTCUTDIMENSION8' (the dimension set up in that slot when the flow runs; 1/2 = Global Dimension 1/2), or SmartText with {{…}} placeholders / SmartControls, resolved with the rest of the configuration before the step runs. Trimmed and upper-cased. An unknown code, an empty result or an unconfigured slot yields empty outputs (no error).

Editor-only: how the config canvas shows 'dimensionCode'. 'smarttext' = SmartText cell; absent = the dimension dropdown (with the slot entries), or the SmartText cell when the code is no option. Also decides the default output name: a 'smarttext' row has none.

Plain-text name the row's outputs are returned under (<name>, <name>_Name, <name>_Code). Default: the trimmed, upper-cased dimensionCode, or 'ShortcutDim<N>' for a slot; a SmartText row has no default and is ignored without one. Unique per step (ignoring case; the first row wins), no {{. The editor writes the default on save.
Written by the config canvas on repeater rows (10000, 20000, …); ignored by this step.

outputs.name: <outputName>
outputs.when: one per row with an output name: the dimension value code, '' if the record has no value for the dimension, the code is empty/unknown or the slot is not set up

outputs.name: <outputName>_Name
outputs.when: one per row: the dimension value name, '' if none

outputs.name: <outputName>_Code
outputs.when: one per row: the dimension code the row resolved to (e.g. the dimension in a General Ledger Setup slot), '' if empty or not set up

notes: Output names come from outputName, defaulting to the trimmed, upper-cased dimensionCode or 'ShortcutDim<N>' for a slot: three per row in configuration order, e.g. {"name":"DEPARTMENT","type":"value"}, {"name":"DEPARTMENT_Name","type":"value"}, {"name":"DEPARTMENT_Code","type":"value"}. Reference them as {{slug_DEPARTMENT}} / {{slug_DEPARTMENT_Name}} / {{slug_DEPARTMENT_Code}}.

Slot rows ('GLSETUP:SHORTCUTDIMENSION1'..'8') read General Ledger Setup when the flow runs, so one flow reads Dim 1-8 in any company. A slot that is not set up returns empty outputs and a Debug log line: 'Shortcut Dimension %1 is not set up in General Ledger Setup – row skipped.'

A dimension code that does not exist, or has no value on the record, yields empty outputs (no error). A code that resolves to empty also writes a Debug log line: 'Dimension row "%1" returned empty: the dimension code is empty.'
The step only reads. It has no 'rec' output and does not count as a writing step for the Confirm dialog publish warning.
The missing-field error message says 'set' because the text is shared with Set Dimension Values.
